integrity: The upper bound is proved by an upward-closure NFA and product emptiness. The lower bound is a symbolic one-hot block encoding of DFA emptiness; no finite experiment is treated as proof. Priority is not certified.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns explicit DFAs over a fixed nontrivial powerset alphabet and logspace many-one reductions. It does not cover NFA input, succinct automata, or positive definability.
title: Fixed-alphabet DFA monotonicity is NL-complete
